Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software, Fabricația de computere și echipamente electronice și Securitatea computerelor și a rețelelor
This leading technology developer is seeking an Embedded Software Architect – Security to be based at their R+D Centre in Bucharest (Graz- or Leuven are also available). The Embedded Software Architect – Security will be working as part of a Crypto & Security team developing emerging secure cryptographic libraries, protected against physical and logical attacks across a variety of product areas. The Embedded Software Architect – Security will be working a MCU / bare-metal level developing architectures from scratch.
 The successful candidate will have several years of experience developing embedded software and bare -metal level software in C for security applications. You will have some experience with software architecture design and development preferably gained in a security / crypto environment and some exposure to cryptographic algorithms and software security (logical / physical attacks) would be beneficial. Coupled with this you should have some experience with ARM and/or RISC-V instructions sets.
 The successful candidate can expect a very attractive salary, 2 bonus payments per year and an extensive benefits package. Flexible working (2 days home office) and on-going career progression is also on offer. To apply contact Adrian Wagstaff on +44 1189 840948 or email your CV to adrian.wagstaff@ic-resources.com
